title: Dekhte jana ali akbar
body:
Akbar Ali Akbar..(3), Ali Akbar
Chala jo khaime se marne rasool jaisa pisar to peeche peeche ye kehte hue chale sarwar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch der to jee le tera..(2), baba ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tum zee'n se giroge to badal jayegi duniya
maqtal ki taraf kaun hamein leke chalega
qatil to bataenge na..(2), rasta ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Beemar e madina ki khabar aati hi hogi
tum saath liye jaate ho beenayi bhi meri
haye mai kaise padhunga khate..(2), sughra ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ho jayega mushkil mera aana mere beta
maqtal mein kahi'n door na jaana mere beta
haye ab mujhse chala bhi nahi jaata ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ehsaas tadapne ka hamare tujhe hota
meri tarah tu apna jigar thaam ke rota
tera bhi jo hota kabhi..(2), beta ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haye nana mere puche jo kaha'n der lagayi
keh dena ijazat badi mushkil se hai paayi
lag jao gale aake..(2), dobara ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Nana gaye jab aayi thi amma pe zaeefi
tum jaate ho haalat hai ajab bint e ali ki
zainab hui jaati hai zaeefa ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aye laal tujhe karta hu baba ke hawale
maidaan mein haste hai khade barchiyo wale
achhi tarha phir dekh lu..(2), seena ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Sar peet ke maula ne takallum ye sadaa di
hai chadar e zainab meri ghurbat ki gawahi
mai tumko kafan de nahi sakta ali akbar
<<MINI>>
Mud mud ke mujhe dekhte jaana ali akbar..(2)
